stage: Step 2, declared before its first life: a teacher's forced alignment on the brain's own beliefs, each letter taught on every frame of its path, read by the CTC reading, on fresh founders beside the supplied alignment and matched CTC baselines.

brain.note: Brain.compose(16, 18, backend='cpu', seed=s, **genes, **arm genes): the 0.97.0 default composition (the recall memory, the heard history of the moment before, the store). The world pays nothing: the reward learner's rates are zero.

forced.role: the 0.97.0 default; the first 500 words taught on the even split of each word's frames among its letters, then every 500 words a frozen copy answers the next 500 words greedily and each word's frames go to its known letters by the monotonic best path through the copy's log beliefs; each letter taught on every frame of its path, space on every silent frame after a word. The path is computed outside the brain and used only as the lesson's labels.

frames.role: the reference: each letter taught on every frame of its sound (the supplied alignment)

modes: online: one pass at the brain's exposure
offline: shuffled epochs to the stopping rule (patience 3, at most 60)

gates.reading: The CTC reading (adjacent repeats once, blanks dropped), the reading the every-frame lesson is built for; the stream as said with nothing merged is reported beside it and is not gated (an every-frame lesson says a letter on each frame of its sound).
gates.emission: forced: inserted characters under .02 per reference character and characters at .95 on the CTC reading, on 5 of 6 founders
gates.words: forced: held-out words said whole at .90 on 5 of 6 founders, beside both CTC baselines
gates.beside: forced against frames paired by founder; the share of letter frames the alignment puts on the letter heard at each re-alignment

stop: One life per process. No setting changes after any life; every life is kept and reported.
